items.exampleEn: It was a tragic end to a great story.
items.exampleZh: 那是一個偉大故事的悲慘結局。

items.exampleEn: She showed great sympathy for her tired classmates.
items.exampleZh: 她很同情那些疲累的同學。

items.exampleEn: After the long exam, I felt mentally tired.
items.exampleZh: 長時間考試後，我覺得精神上很疲累。

items.exampleEn: She gave me an encouraging smile before the test.
items.exampleZh: 考試前，她給了我一個鼓勵的微笑。

items.exampleEn: I had a strange sensation that someone was watching me.
items.exampleZh: 我有一種奇怪的感覺，好像有人在看我。

items.exampleEn: He felt depressed after losing his job.
The cat looked at the box with curiosity.
items.exampleZh: 貓帶著好奇心看著箱子。

items.exampleEn: A supportive team makes work much easier.
items.exampleZh: 一個彼此支持的團隊會讓工作輕鬆許多。

items.sentenceEn: Thank you for being so supportive.

items.audioEn: Your work this term was very encouraging. Keep it up!
items.audioZh: 你這學期的表現很令人鼓舞，繼續保持！
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得對方這學期表現如何？

items.sentenceEn: I lost all sensation in my cold fingers.
items.sentenceZh: 我冰冷的手指完全失去了感覺。

items.sentenceEn: My friends showed sympathy when my bike was stolen.
items.sentenceZh: 我的腳踏車被偷時，朋友們都很同情我。

items.stemEn: Her friends were very ____ when she decided to start her own business.
items.stemZh: 她決定自己創業時，朋友們都非常支持她。

items.stemEn: Children are full of ____ and ask many questions.
items.stemZh: 孩子們充滿好奇心，會問很多問題。

items.passageEn: Last month, I read a tragic novel about a poor young girl who had to leave her family and work in a big city. The story made me feel depressed for a few days, and I had a lot of sympathy for the girl. But the ending was encouraging: a kind old woman took care of her, and the girl later became a doctor. When the book came out, it caused a sensation, and many people talked about it. My curiosity made me look up the writer online. She said she wrote the book to help people stay mentally strong in hard times. The book also gave me a new insight into how people get through hard times. My mom, who is always supportive, bought me the writer's next book.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我讀了一本悲慘的小說，講一個貧窮的小女孩不得不離開家人、到大城市工作的故事。這個故事讓我沮喪了好幾天，我非常同情那個女孩。不過結局令人鼓舞：一位善良的老太太照顧她，女孩後來成了醫生。這本書出版時引起了轟動，很多人都在討論。好奇心讓我上網查了作者的資料。她說她寫這本書，是為了幫助人們在困難時保持心理上的堅強。這本書也讓我對人們如何度過難關有了新的認識。總是很支持我的媽媽，買了這位作者的下一本書給我。

questions.questionZh: 讀完故事後作者有什麼感覺？

options: 女孩找到了失散的家人
老太太照顧她，她後來當了醫生

items.promptZh: 下雨天總讓我覺得很沮喪。
referenceEn: Rainy days always make me feel depressed.
I always feel depressed on rainy days.
rubricZh: depressed 表示「沮喪的」，例如 feel depressed 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說習慣用現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 出於好奇，他問了那位老人很多問題。
referenceEn: Out of curiosity, he asked the old man many questions.
He asked the old man a lot of questions out of curiosity.
rubricZh: 用 out of curiosity 表示「出於好奇」
